description: Plays a chord progression as an MPX stream, so the modules downstream have a harmony to work against

params.text: Sets the key it is played in, the twelve semitones
Sets the tempo when no clock is patched, 30 to 300 beats per minute

inputs.text: Advances the progression; patching anything here overrides the tempo knob
Returns the progression to its first chord

outputs.text: Carries the progression on as an MPX stream

notes: mpx OUT carries a note stream, not a voltage; patch it to another DreamerMPX module's mpx IN, or to fromMPX where ordinary voltages are wanted
a cable between two MPX jacks turns pink once it has taken; a cable from an MPX jack to anything else keeps its ordinary colour and carries nothing
an MPX cable carries a note stream rather than a voltage and goes to an MPX input; fromMPX turns a stream back into gates and pitch for the wider rack
